season_weather_time.note: Rain-cloud imagery is explicit weather evidence.

flora.note: Leafy greens and cultivated grains/crops are retained as exact source flora/subsistence plants.

fauna.note: `கொல்களிறு` is retained as source fauna/gift animal.

people_social_roles.note: Elderly mother, woman, children, forest people, household/group, patron and poet are retained as source roles.

relationships.note: Mother/child, household, speaker/patron and recipient relationships are explicit.

emotion_lived_experience.note: Lament, poverty suffering, hunger, desire for willing generosity and family relief are explicit lived experience.

occupations_production.note: Forest-field preparation/burning and sowing are explicit production/cultivation evidence.

food_subsistence.note: Nursing failure, greens, no salt/buttermilk, simple food and hunger are explicit subsistence evidence.

clothing_ornaments_adornment.note: Dirty/worn clothing is explicit clothing evidence.

material_culture_everyday_objects.note: Walking staff and clothing are explicit material objects.

weapons_warfare.note: `கூர்வேல்` is retained as explicit weapon epithet; no separate battle event is inferred.

economy.note: Gift size versus willing giving and the speaker's acceptance/refusal principles are explicit patronage/economic evidence.

communities_social_groups.note: `கானவர்` and `ஒக்கல்` are retained as source groups without later identity substitution.

family_gender_kinship.note: Elderly mother, children, nursing woman and household/`ஒக்கல்` relations are explicit kinship/gender evidence.

death_mourning_memory.note: The elderly mother's lament that her life does not depart is retained as death-oriented speech only; no actual death is inferred.

arts_music_performance.note: Praise/fame and the speaker's self-identification as singer are retained as poetic-performance evidence.

knowledge_technology.note: Field preparation and sowing are retained as practical production knowledge.

values_ethical_concepts.note: `அறம்`, refusal of an unwilling large gift and preference for a willing small gift are explicit ethical reasoning.

body_health.note: Old age/frailty, pale body, exhausted breast, hunger and bodily deprivation are explicit body/health evidence.
